parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly made of aluminum, consisting of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to generate airflow, converting rotational energy from the motor into air movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: This is the outlier or motor housing part made of steel, connecting the fan blades to the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan blades and houses the motor shaft, ensuring stable rotation and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the fan blades rotate around it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the fan made of plastic, providing structural support for all components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan assembly, motor, and other components in place, ensuring stability and safety.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.
